description:
The Bella Evo frameset includes a headset, seat struts/clamps, seat/frame clamp, idler system, 3-piece riser system and handle bar. So grab your favorite components and build your dream recumbent!
Frameset is disk brake only using a post-mounted system and requires 135mm/100mm QR hubs. The rear wheel can be converted to 142mm thru-axle, if desired.
Weight limit - 325lbs
Weight of frame and seat clamp - 8 pounds, 1 oz (medium), 8 pounds, 6 oz (large)
Weight of dual idler assembly - 18 oz
Weight of 3-Piece riser system and lower riser clamp - 17.5 oz
Weight of handlebar - 11.2 oz
Weight of seat struts/clamps - 8 oz
